purpose: TASK-029 Goods Receipt Draft create, update and cancel over real HTTP, JWT and MySQL: receivable-PO gate, full replace across UOM, warehouse, bin and status, typed refusals for foreign lines, wrong UOM, bin outside its warehouse, duplicate buckets, zero quantity and stale versions, the Inventory-bound reason byte rule, cancel only in DRAFT, permission, replay and the duplicate delivery-note warning; PO progress and Inventory unchanged. Carries the unchanged TASK-025 and TASK-028 cases; Opening parser, precheck and scoped atomic posting guard against invalid/double stock writes, stale Item codes and unsafe lot keys. TASK-032 adds HTTP/JWT/MySQL confirmation against real Inventory posting: atomic two-line posting, PO progress/history, procurement audit and full receipt, idempotent replay and event conflict, locked over-receipt and reasons, inactive or mismatched locations, rollback after posting or subsequent write failures, blocked supplier quarantine, invalid/empty lines and missing lot, permission/version/state refusals, SKU tracking drift and short-expiry authorization and evidence. Three TASK-033 real HTTP/MySQL cases verify operation owner and permission loss, receipt list/detail, and receivable PO/warehouse/bin lookups.
data: TASK-029 file: 9 registrations sharing one application and pool; 2 users, 1 supplier, 1 item, 2 UOMs, 2 SKUs, 3 SKU-UOMs, 2 warehouses, 3 bins; at most 3 POs, 2 GRs and 4 details per case, POs written by SQL; about 50 HTTP requests in the file, with the per-IP request limit raised for the test application only. TASK-025 and TASK-028 data unchanged. No fixture files; Opening routine adds 7 in-memory cases with at most 5,001 small lines in a parser-only count check, otherwise at most 6 lines. Explicit local suite only: 9 cases, one fresh isolated MySQL 26.7 schema, one warehouse, two bins, two SKUs and two actors, at most two positive rows per file. TASK-032: 9 registrations share one application and pool, with 3 users and 3 roles, 1 supplier, 1 item, 2 UOMs, 2 SKUs, 3 SKU-UOM links, 2 warehouses and 3 bins. The file creates 9 two-line POs by SQL, 10 GR drafts by HTTP and issues 30 serial confirm requests. Per case: 1 PO, at most 2 GRs and 6 confirm requests; per request: at most 2 lines and 2 details. In-process fault stubs and one temporary PO progress trigger are restored or removed in finally; the per-IP request limit applies to the test application only. All TASK-032 fixtures are inline. Extends the shared Confirm fixture with one receiving user/role and one temporary lapsed-permission user/role in C8. Adds five two-line POs, three drafts, three confirms and 19 sequential GET requests across three cases. A bin is made inactive and restored. No additional runner or fixture files.
concurrency: Within a case: 1, with no concurrent requests. Runner workers unchanged; Opening cases serial per file, one isolated database and HTTP app for the explicit local cases only.
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged; no timing threshold; Opening routine 7/7 and explicit local 9/9, both zero skips. All 9 TASK-032 cases must pass, including exact stock and PO effects, zero additional effect on replay or rejection, atomic rollback of injected faults, and persisted exception evidence. All three new cases and all inherited cases must pass, with existing coverage floors.
trigger: The existing ci.yml triggers in the existing server jobs; no new job. Opening routine unit files use existing discovery; nine guarded native cases must be executed via explicit local server/scripts/inventoryOpening.integration.js. No CI job, discovery flag or workflow change. TASK-032 uses the existing server integration discovery and job.
cost: Not measured. A 2026-11-19 local serial run of the 12 Purchasing integration files (107 cases) was history, not a promise. No capacity workload; Seven small Opening units with no database calls, no separate CI overhead measurement. Explicit local MySQL/HTTP suite took about 1.3 seconds after schema migration. No new non-functional workload. TASK-032 CI execution time has not been measured. This adds a serial functional suite without a timing or capacity workload.
